intro: In the 4 official DSSSB TGT Computer Science papers of 2023–24 there were {n} programming questions, about 11–12 per paper. About one in five is a 'What is the output?' question (C pointers, Java literals, Python tuples); the rest are one-line facts on C, C++, Java and Python, plus .NET (CLR, MSIL, C#, VB.NET) and Pandas, which DSSSB asks even though the syllabus line does not name them. Trace every output question line by line, as these notes show.
